name: a1_fea_briefidx
desc: fea (d8,An,Xn) NCC=6(1/1/0) + MOVE EA,Dn NCC=2(0/1/0), MC68030UM.pdf 11-27/11-37 -- naive additive sum predicts p=2 (fea's own r/p/w=1/1/0 + MOVE-op's own 0/1/0), but this RTL physically fetches opcode+brief-extension-word together in ONE bus read (same address-range-attributed count as a1_fea_d16an, whose OWN naive sum is p=1 and matches). Documented divergence, not a bug: real 68030 silicon's own internal microcode may charge brief-indexed decode an extra prefetch beyond what the physical byte-fetch count alone would predict (needing to have already decoded the opcode before it can act on the extension word's own scale/index fields) that this project's simplified comb-decode pipeline doesn't reproduce -- see plan.md Phase 161 Part A Stage A1.
